before.pdp_how_to_use_raw: FACE: As a stand-alone facial oil: Apply a few drops to clean, damp skin for deep nourishment and antioxidant protection. As a primer: Smooth a light layer before makeup for a radiant, even finish. Blended with skincare: Add 1–2 drops to your daily cream or sunscreen to boost hydration and antioxidant defense. Night repair ritual: Massage in before bed for overnight regeneration and a morning glow. BODY: Post-shower ritual: Massage onto damp skin after using PROPOWAX™ Shower Gel and Body Lotion. Locks in moisture, leaving skin satin-soft and perfectly dry to the touch. Targeted care: Focus on dry areas such as elbows, knees, or décolleté for instant softness and luminosity. Evening indulgence: Apply before bed as a full-body treatment — wake up with supple, nourished skin enveloped in fragrance. HAIR: For dry or damaged hair: Use as an intensive hair & scalp mask. Massage generously, leave on for 2–3 hours, then wash with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo. After rinsing, apply a few drops as a leave-on for lasting smoothness and shine. For normal or oily hair: Use as a pre-shampoo mask. Apply to scalp and strands, leave for a few hours, then rinse. Restores balance, smoothness, and natural shine without heaviness.

after.pdp_how_to_use_raw:
FACE:

As a stand-alone facial oil: Apply a few drops to clean, damp skin for deep nourishment and antioxidant protection.
As a primer: Smooth a light layer before makeup for a radiant, even finish.
Blended with skincare: Add 1–2 drops to your daily cream or sunscreen to boost hydration and antioxidant defense.
Night repair ritual: Massage in before bed for overnight regeneration and a morning glow.

BODY:

Post-shower ritual: Massage onto damp skin after using PROPOWAX™ Shower Gel and Body Lotion. Locks in moisture, leaving skin satin-soft and perfectly dry to the touch.
Targeted care: Focus on dry areas such as elbows, knees, or décolleté for instant softness and luminosity.
Evening indulgence: Apply before bed as a full-body treatment — wake up with supple, nourished skin enveloped in fragrance.

HAIR:

For dry or damaged hair: Use as an intensive hair & scalp mask. Massage generously, leave on for 2–3 hours, then wash with PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Shampoo. After rinsing, apply a few drops as a leave-on for lasting smoothness and shine.
For normal or oily hair: Use as a pre-shampoo mask. Apply to scalp and strands, leave for a few hours, then rinse. Restores balance, smoothness, and natural shine without heaviness.
